==About==

A {{i|Franklin Bar}} is obtained by chance when breaking open a {{i|Loot Pignatta}} or by gathering them from a {{i|Gingerbread House}} Franklin Bars restores All Food Groups by 30% with a 40% '''EXCEPT''' for {{i2|Fruit}}. A Franklin Bar be stored a {{i|Candy Basket}}. Older pilgrims may be interested in [[Trading|Buying]] this item from you.
